master.label: Turn on self-evolution
master.description: When off, nothing is collected, learned or rolled out, and candidate versions return to their stable versions. Existing data is kept.

mode.label: How it runs

descriptions.observe: Collects feedback and statistics without proposing changes.
descriptions.propose: Proposed changes wait for your review.
descriptions.auto: Changes are applied after they pass evaluation.

mode.autoWarning: Automatic changes still go through evaluation and a gradual rollout, and you can roll them back at any time.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Change these only if you understand how evaluation and rollout work.

hints.candidate_traffic: Share of conversations that use a candidate, greater than 0 and at most 1.
hints.promote_threshold: Confidence a candidate is better before it becomes stable, greater than 0 and at most 1.
hints.rollback_threshold: Confidence below which a candidate is rolled back; lower than the promotion threshold.
hints.win_rate: Share of comparisons a candidate must win in evaluation, from 0.5 to 1.
hints.max_diversity_drop: Largest allowed loss of output diversity versus stable, from 0 to 0.5.

errors.range_traffic: Enter a number greater than 0 and at most 1.
errors.rollback_not_below: Must be lower than the promotion threshold.
errors.positive_integer: Enter a positive whole number or leave it empty.

costDialog.title: Turn on self-evolution?
costDialog.body: Signal classification, learning and evaluation make extra calls to the selected model and use tokens. Usage is unlimited by default; you can set a monthly limit in Advanced.
